focus: Frontier node F-2-004 (depth 2, scope .skilled/skills/system-skilled-bots/, OpenBot-main/api/openapi/memory.yaml): How does an OpenBot memory reviewState (unreviewed, confirmed, edited) map onto a skilled-bots needs-you item?
noveltyJustification: 9 of 11 findings are new external evidence from the needs-you surface; 2 are new design inferences that build on the item shape.
keyQuestions: How do the reference repos build bot memory (per-bot and shared) and skills (written, recorded from a demonstration, proposed from use), and how would those map onto Skilled skills and the spec-kit?
answeredQuestions: How does an OpenBot memory reviewState (unreviewed, confirmed, edited) map onto a skilled-bots needs-you item?
ruledOut: Reusing NeedsYouItem verbatim for memory review
Adding a third edited review state
A separate review UI beside bots inbox

label: A needs-you item is written by the runner, not the model: the child prints a [NEEDS-DECISION] line with optional [OPTION] lines, the runner writes one item and ends the run awaiting-decision with exit 5.

The item shape is {id, runId, botId, identity, question, options, createdAt, expiresAt, evidence, prompt, specFolder, answer, resumeRequestId}, and id is the parked run's id so one run writes at most one item.
Item state is open | answered | expired, derived from its fields every time it is read and never stored, so it can never disagree with them.
An open item holds every later run of its bot, refused before dispatch, and the hold lifts once the item is answered or expires.
An item expires after the repository's needs-you expiry, seven days by default, and an expired item is listed as expired without being rewritten.
bots answer <item-id> <text> secret-checks the answer, writes it on the item, and enqueues one resume request keyed by the item id.
The resumed run's prompt is the parked prompt, then the question, options and answer, with an instruction to continue; it binds the same spec folder and reopens the kept worktree.
The item already carries evidence: string[], the same field OpenBot's proposal review needs for the conversations and recordings a fact was learned from.

The mapping is partial: a memory review is not run-scoped, but a needs-you item's id is the parked run's id and an open item holds the bot, so verbatim reuse would hold a bot on every unreviewed fact.

The smallest correct mapping is a review item with the same file shape and derived state but no hold and no resume: id becomes the fact id, prompt/specFolder/resumeRequestId drop out, answer becomes confirmed | rejected.
OpenBot's three-value reviewState collapses to two: unreviewed is the item's open state and confirmed is the answered state; edited is the answer text, not a third state.

direction: Reuse NeedsYouItem verbatim for memory review
reason: id is the run id and an open item holds the bot, so one unreviewed fact would stop every later run of that bot.

direction: Add a third edited review state
reason: The answer text already carries the rewrite; a third state needs its own transitions for no recall benefit.

direction: Build a separate review UI beside bots inbox
reason: bots inbox already lists open items and bots answer resolves them; a second surface duplicates the same question.
